Job Title:  Native  Android mobile app developer 
 Location: Dallas, TX 
 Duration: Full Time 
 
 Job Description: 
 
 · Have at least 2 years of solid native Android mobile app development experience 
 · Experience with various android OS versions 
 · Other technical skills like HTML, SQL, XML/JSON, Restful web services 
 · Experience in dealing with senior member of the business units (within the organization) and product owners 
 · Experience in SDLC with emphasis on specifying, building, and testing mission critical business applications 
 · Working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence and other Agile work management tools 
 · Strong analytical and prioritization skills. 


 Full Time
